page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some consonants in this worn print are doubtful and are not checked letter by letter; the Hebrew forms are the closest reading of the scan, and several are marked [?] in the text only where the reading is least sure. Hebrew roots are not verified against the printed forms. The left-hand line "מְהַבִּלִים" and the right-hand root "הָכַם" are uncertain. The top-left page number is a worn mark read as 30. The running heads are Hebrew letters: ה (left) and מח (right). A small signature mark at the left foot is illegible and omitted. The Latin "Pyh." is printed as such.
